focused_output_only.label: Focused monitor only
focused_output_only.description: Show only the focused monitor's workspaces instead of this monitor's.

show_empty_workspaces.label: Show empty workspaces
show_empty_workspaces.description: Show chips for workspaces with no windows. The active workspace is always shown.

display.label: Workspace label
display.description: What each chip shows: the workspace index, its name (falls back to the index), its window count, or a bare pill.

window_titles.label: Window titles
window_titles.description: Show a truncated window title next to window tiles: never, only on the hovered tile, or always. Forced off in a vertical (side) bar.

max_windows_per_workspace.label: Max windows per workspace
max_windows_per_workspace.description: Cap on expanded window tiles per workspace before collapsing the rest into a +N label.

labels_only_when_occupied.label: Labels only when occupied
labels_only_when_occupied.description: Hide the label on empty, inactive workspace chips, leaving a bare pill.

max_label_chars.label: Max label characters
max_label_chars.description: Truncate workspace name labels to this many characters. Purely numeric labels are never truncated.

only_active_workspace.label: Only active workspace windows
only_active_workspace.description: Show window tiles only for each monitor's active workspace. Other workspace chips still render.

icon_size.label: Icon size
icon_size.description: Window app icon size in pixels.

chip_ratio.label: Idle chip stretch (%)
chip_ratio.description: Idle chip width-to-height ratio: 100 is a circle, 140 a compact oval, 300+ approaches a line. Chips always round into circles on expand.

collapse_delay_ms.label: Collapse delay
collapse_delay_ms.description: Hover linger before collapse, in milliseconds.

show_focus_dot.label: Show focus dot
show_focus_dot.description: Show a dot under the focused window's tile.
